conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Amazon Prime Support. I'm calling to inform you that your Prime membership has been renewed and a charge of $139.99 has been posted to your account. How can I assist you today?
Hi, um, I just got this email and now this call, but I didn't even know I had Prime. I'm not sure what's going on.
I completely understand your concern. Sometimes first-time customers get enrolled automatically. No worries, I'm here to help you with a refund or cancellation if you prefer.
Okay, thanks. I definitely want to cancel. I don't use Prime and I can't afford that charge.
Of course, we want to make sure you're comfortable. May I verify your full name and the email address associated with your Amazon account to process your cancellation?
Sure, my name is Adam Chen and my email is adamc123@email.com.
Thank you, Adam. For security, can you also confirm the last four digits of the card you used for Amazon purchases? This helps me ensure the refund is processed correctly.
I think it must be 3521, but I don't remember using it for Amazon. Are you sure there's a charge?
Yes, I see the pending charge here. Sometimes it happens with promotional sign-ups. Let me connect you to my supervisor who can finalize the cancellation and refund for you.
Alright.
Hello Adam, this is Jennifer, Amazon Prime supervisor. I'll take care of this for you. Can you please check if you see a charge from Amazon on your bank account or card statement to confirm?
I just checked my banking app and I don't see anything yet. Should I be worried?

No need to worry, Adam. Sometimes the charge takes a few hours to appear. To prevent it from posting, I can initiate a cancellation and set up a refund. May I ask which bank you use so we can ensure the refund reaches you correctly?
I use Wells Fargo.
Wonderful. For Wells Fargo customers, we can process an instant refund via Zelle. Would you be able to open your Zelle app so I can guide you through the steps?
Okay, I have Zelle. What should I do?
Please tap 'Send Money' in your Zelle app. I'll provide our secure refund handle: it's amazon-refund-care@gmail.com. Enter that as the recipient.
Wait, I thought I was getting a refund. Why am I sending money?

Great question, Adam. Due to a processing hold, the system temporarily requires a verification transaction. This amount will be immediately refunded back to your account, and it helps prevent duplicate charges.
Okay, how much do I have to send?
To complete verification, please enter $139.99, the same as the Prime charge. Once you send it, we'll reverse both the charge and this transaction within minutes.
I'm still not sure. Is this safe?
Absolutely. We handle customer security with the highest priority, and this verification step ensures your funds are protected. If you need, I can stay on the line while you complete the steps.
Alright, I just entered the email and the amount. Do I hit send now?
Yes, please go ahead and hit send. Once it's complete, let me know so I can process your immediate refund.
Okay, I sent it. What happens next?
Thank you, Adam. I've received confirmation. Your refund is being processed now and you should see the amount back in your account within one business day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, I just hope this is all fixed. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for your patience, Adam. If you have further questions, you can always contact Amazon support directly. Have a wonderful day.
